# Browser dependencies

Vendored production bundles to avoid runtime CDN requests:

- Lightweight Charts 5.0.8, TradingView, Apache-2.0.
  Source: https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@5.0.8/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js
- Lucide 0.468.0, ISC (includes Feather icons under MIT).
  Source: https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js

License and NOTICE files are kept alongside the bundles.
The stock chart displays a TradingView attribution link.
